source: Find a Tender and Contracts Finder award-stage OCDS notices, Open Government Licence v3, plus 9 legacy rows imported from the retired page 703 on 21/08/2026.
scopeRule: AWARDS only — a notice appears here once it has resolved to an award, never while it is open for bidding (open notices live in data/open-tenders.json). Scope is CPV division 33 (medical equipment, pharmaceuticals and personal care products) by headline classification, or a high-confidence device term in the title. Buyer names are never matched on.

coverage.note: Find a Tender is walked back to a probed floor of 2021-01-01. Contracts Finder's API honours no date filter, so its history is reached only by paging the whole UK public-sector notice stream; this export reaches back to 2026-05-05 on that feed and its earlier history is a known gap, not a claim of completeness. An absence here is a statement about this index, never about the buyer or the market.

endDateNote: Only 211 of 1972 awards carry a contract end date. Find a Tender award notices mostly do not publish one, so the forward contract calendar is limited by what the feeds state, not by what this page displays — a missing end date is unknown, never 'no end date'.
